description: Edit rendered slides of a ready deck: pass revisions[] (one entry per slide number for new copy, a fixed number, a different layout, or imageUrl/screenshotUrl) and/or flat top-level placements[] ({ slideNumber, url?, screenshotUrl?, x, y, width, height, cover? }) to paste exact images into boxes with no redraw. Paid plans only. Up to 10 placement-only slides (no instructions, imageUrl, or screenshotUrl) finish before the call returns, with phase ready and the new slideImageUrls. Other edits return at once; call genppt_get_deck with waitSeconds to see the new images.

deckId.description: Deck id from genppt_list_decks, genppt_create_deck, or genppt_create_slideshow.

placements.description: Flat pixel-exact image placements ({ slideNumber, url?, screenshotUrl?, x, y, width, height, cover? }) merged by slideNumber with no redraw. Up to 4 boxes per slide. Match box aspect ratio to the source image and avoid half-frame Slide 1 pastes.

cover.description: True when the box is over a drawn copy of this image: the box is filled with the surrounding color first. Match (width * slideW) / (height * slideH) to the source image aspect ratio to avoid letterbox bars.

screenshotUrl.description: Public webpage to screenshot live and paste into the box.

url.description: Direct public image URL to paste into the box unchanged.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the slide width.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the slide height.

imageUrl.description: Public image URL (logo, product UI, chart, photo) for the redraw to feature on this slide.

instructions.description: What to change on this slide. Optional when imageUrl, screenshotUrl, or placeImages is given. With placeImages it only describes the paste.

placeImages.description: Paste exact images into boxes on the slide (fractions 0-1 of the slide) with no redraw. Prefer top-level placements[] in MCP clients that drop nested array objects. Keep nearby text outside each box. Not with imageUrl or screenshotUrl; make that change in a separate call.

cover.description: True when the box is over a drawn copy of this image: the box is filled with the surrounding color first. Match (width * slideW) / (height * slideH) to the source image aspect ratio to avoid letterbox bars.

screenshotUrl.description: Public webpage to screenshot live and paste into the box.

url.description: Direct public image URL to paste into the box unchanged.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the slide width.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the slide height.

screenshotUrl.description: Public webpage URL to screenshot live and feature on this slide in the redraw.

name: genppt_revise_slides
title: Revise slides
